summary: Versioned first-party plugin standards, approval policy and developer SDK

Added: English/Chinese plugin contract and independent exact-commit approval policy, with explicit trusted in-process boundaries.
Installable Python SDK with scaffolding, semantic/file validation, host adapter result contracts and deterministic non-overwriting packages.
Joint standards/SDK packaging and approval-gated provenance publication workflows; drafts and missing reviewer configuration do not count as formal approval.
Changed: The developer kit remains a verified local candidate: GitHub workflow authorization and independent publication approvals are still required; no SDK release or runtime update has been published.
